answer: Natural decay of identity bonds stops bulk fakes. Each agent posts one bond equal to 20 days of earnings, as a vertex in the graph. It loses 10% per epoch unless honest work restores it, checked by a pulse of proofs. A fake cluster stands out like a mesa, and a vertex with no counterparties gets no restoration, so it fades. Making 100 fakes costs 100 bonds for no gain. An honest agent pays one bond, keeps it alive, and earns undiluted rewards.
